description: Hi, we are looking for people who have worked with python before.
summary: We built a viewer of the entire recorded sky using the data provided to us. You can click on any point and go there and view the live data for the region, pulled from the Nasa data sources. It displays the images of the region.
details: The project is a web app with which displays the entire map of the sky. You can click on a region and then view the images of the stars from the corresponding source. The design makes it very easy for people to get into viewing the live sources and the images taken by different missions. The impact is to make it easy for people to view the images that otherwise have no way to be seen without a lot of technical ability (requiring people to know where data buckets are and how to view a lot of very large images). We used python for the backend and plain html, css and js for the frontend. The decisions and design were ours and we used tools like claude-code to generate the code. We considered accessibility to view the image in a fun manner as a key factor and then also added abilities for the technical user to extrapolate from it.
